p-howlerbros-8288822034547.d:
THE YELLOW ROSE 10TH ANNIVERSARY COLLECTION
Ten years ago, we joined forces with Austin City Limits Music Festival to make apparel celebrating one of the country’s most iconic music festivals happening right here in our own backyard. A decade, a whole lot of music and more than a few collectable pieces later, we’re still at it. This year’s Yellow Rose Collection celebrates our tenth Howler Brothers for Austin City Limits Music Festival endeavor with nods to where we’ve been and some new tricks for where we’re headed. Here’s to ten years. Turn it up!
Our H Bar B Snapshirt is one of our most popular releases every season because of its glorious pearl snaps and timeless good looks. It is THE new classic pearl snap shortsleeve. We twist it up each season in our very own vintage inspired prints and plaids with our HB original sunglass cleaning microfiber at the hem. There’s a whole stampede of imitators out there trying to get in the pasture with their own version of this shirt. Choose your horse wisely and make sure it’s branded H Bar B.
The Yellow Rose 10th Anniversary Collection was made in limited quantities and is NOT eligible for discounts.
